description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/weno5_eno1_D1x_extrapolate_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=8 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the per-axis hybrid WENO5/ENO1 upwind x-derivative D(u, wrt: x) (priority 10) replaced by the rule's body (seven regions: hybrid interior block [4,5]x[3,6], ENO1 strips [4,5]x[1,2], [4,5]x[7,8], [2,3]x[1,8], [6,7]x[1,8], and the two guarded-extrapolation ghost wall lines i=1, i=8) carrying the free names dx, dy, wind_u, wind_v, bdy_eno1_cells, weno_band_cells, with zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise (or by sha256 digest when >= 64 KiB) by the other bindings.
